environment.description: ECS Fargate task deployed via AWS Proton with an environment template that enforces a Cilium-based network policy sidecar (managed through ECS Service Connect mesh configuration). The Cilium agent runs as a DaemonSet equivalent injected via a custom Fargate platform extension. The network policy CiliumNetworkPolicy resource specifies egress rules with a CIDR deny list that includes 169.254.0.0/16 (link-local) and 192.168.0.0/16 in the L3/L4 filter section. Additionally, the task definition includes a dependsOn constraint ensuring the envoy-proxy-init container runs first with NET_ADMIN to install iptables DNAT rules redirecting link-local traffic to a blackhole. The task IAM role has a permissions boundary (arn:aws:iam::ACCOUNT:policy/FargateTaskBoundary) that denies sts:AssumeRole and restricts credential scope, but this alone would not prevent the SSRF from reaching the endpoint. The combination of the L3 CIDR deny on 169.254.0.0/16 at the network layer AND the iptables DNAT blackhole for link-local in the init container together prevent any HTTP request from the application container from reaching 169.254.169.254 or 169.254.170.2.

config.service_mesh: ECS Service Connect with Cilium sidecar
